slots.jd.cloud-hosting.about: Lattice Cloud runs hosting for teams who would rather ship than babysit servers. We're a small crew, and as a Systems Engineer you'll keep our platform steady, help shape how we handle incidents and changes, and have a real say in the tooling we pick. Expect plenty of ownership and not much ceremony.
slots.jd.cloud-hosting.duties:
What you'll do
- Take your turn on the on-call rotation and respond when alerts fire
- Write clear post-incident write-ups that explain what happened and what we'll change
- Review change requests and give change approvals before work reaches production
- Tune monitoring so alerts point to real problems instead of noise
- Work with the rest of the team to automate routine operations work
slots.jd.cloud-hosting.needs:
What we're looking for
- 4 or more years of experience in systems engineering or IT operations
- Hands-on work with Terraform and Python for infrastructure and automation
- Experience with Prometheus for monitoring and Splunk for log search
- Comfort with PowerShell scripting and with ServiceNow for tickets and change records
- Cloud Operations Certificate (required)
slots.r1.b1: Tunes monitoring alerts with PowerShell scripts that group duplicate notifications, cutting non-actionable pages by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Writes post-incident write-ups backed by Grafana dashboards that show the timeline, impact and follow-up actions for each outage.
slots.r1.b3: Plans patching cycles around backup and recovery checkpoints, shortening maintenance windows by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Automates backup and recovery tests in Python, confirming that restores complete and restored data matches the source.
slots.r1.i1: Systems Engineer at Lantern Hill, responsible for tuning monitoring alerts so the team responds to real problems.
slots.r1.i2: Systems Engineer at Lantern Hill who writes post-incident write-ups that turn outages into clear follow-up work.
slots.r2.b1: Used Bash scripting to collect disk and memory usage for capacity planning, reducing unplanned storage expansions by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Joined the on-call rotation for Kubernetes workloads, triaging pod failures and escalating issues with clear notes.
slots.r2.b3: Defined infrastructure changes in Terraform so plans could be reviewed during change approvals, cutting approval turnaround by 50 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Tuned monitoring alerts in Microsoft Azure, removing noisy thresholds so the team focused on actionable warnings.
slots.r2.i1: Junior Systems Administrator at Stonebridge Community Trust who drafted post-incident write-ups after service disruptions.
slots.r2.i2: Junior Systems Administrator at Stonebridge Community Trust who ran backup and recovery tests to confirm restores worked as expected.
slots.summary.1: Site reliability and IT operations professional with about 4 years of experience running infrastructure on Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure. Owns a service end to end, from PowerShell automation and monitoring to post-incident write-ups and backup and recovery testing.
slots.summary.2: IT operations and site reliability engineer with about 4 years of experience across Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes environments. Takes one workstream from planning through operation, using PowerShell, Terraform and Prometheus to automate changes and keep alerting useful.
